title: A notification-setting change is recorded (no audit screen in v1)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. A customer whose "Maintenance notifications" toggle you can change.
custom_steps:
1. Turn the customer's "Maintenance notifications" toggle off and back on.
  2. Look in the product for any screen showing who changed it and when.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The toggle changes and stays changed after a reload.
  • That each change was recorded with who made it and when cannot be checked by hand in v1 — no screen shows the audit; it is for a developer or automated check.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S21 (S21-R7, S21-N3); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

  • S21-R7: “A change to a customer's notification setting is recorded with who made it and when”
